question: I've been wondering for ages—would you draw gender-swapped versions of The Worst Generation for us? In face, please do!!!
answer: I got so many requests for this. I mean, I'll do it, but it's creepy, okay? Check it out on page 166. I haven't shown Blackbeard since the timeskip yet, so he's not included. That's all for the SBS. See you next volume! *Hawkins: "What's your sign? I'll read your daily love horoscope" *Law: "How many people did you kill, Drakey?" *Bege: "I told you, my military force and cosmetics are on a different level!" *Kid: "Wanna form a ladies night alliance?" *Drake: "I have no interest... in Pacifistas." *Killer: "I bought pancakes and macaroons, so can we all get along?" *Bonney: "Donburi! One more donburi!" *Apoo: "Apyapya! Don't you know how cute I am!?" *Urouge: "Ew, those Celestial Dragons are like, so lame!"
name: Momokichi
